correctness.rationale: Both admissibility conditions are hereditary under prefixes; for each newly appended symbol an overlap must be a suffix of period p and length 2p+1, checked by comparing p+1 consecutive positions shifted by p. An overlap-free source is cube-free, so the next curling digit is 2 exactly when an equal-block square is a suffix. I exhaustively enumerated labeled prefixes through depth 85 using an independent bit-plane depth-first traversal: shifted XOR masks test suffix periods in both alphabets, without quotienting source labels. At 84 the two printed length-84 outputs occurred with frequencies 4032 and 2016, respectively, with common prefix length 83; at 85 no admissible prefix survived. This independently corroborates the canonical enumeration and the full search in the frozen evidence. The sixfold size of each canonical orbit at 84 follows from using all three symbols, which both the frozen canonical check and known extremal characterization support.
residual_risks: The exact finite enumeration proves the terminal image claim; it does not classify fibers at other lengths or alphabet sizes. No formal or expert verification is claimed.
